- brevity-prompt: Chrome extension (MV3) that compresses LLM prompts in-browser by 40–65%, zero external dependencies, 25/25 tests — https://github.com/sebin-gg/brevity-prompt

- Kindred: volunteer community-impact platform — Express 5 + React 19 + MongoDB + JWT — https://github.com/sebin-gg/kindred

- career-bridge: local-AI résumé-to-job matcher that keeps data on-device — https://github.com/sebin-gg/career-bridge
